# Starlight Technology

> Buying intelligence and complete-system design for AI-native creators and small teams.

Canonical: https://starlight.technology
Methodology: https://starlight.technology/methodology
Disclosure: https://starlight.technology/disclosure
Sitemap: https://starlight.technology/sitemap.xml

## Editorial boundary

Every analysis declares whether evidence is owned-and-tested, hands-on, source-backed research, or decision-model inference. Research-only pages must not be represented as hands-on testing. Prices require a merchant/source, region, currency and verification timestamp.

## Main collections

- /builds — complete systems by objective and planning budget
- /compare — constraint-led comparisons
- /guides — decision frameworks
- /shop — source-backed technology Atlas and coverage map
- /shop/studio — local, exportable system brief and conservative decision model
- /shop/estate — private local equipment ledger with JSON export/import; no remote sync or robot commands

## Read-only technology APIs

- /api/technology/catalog — versioned research records and source dates
- /api/technology/search?q=robot — local TF-IDF vector retrieval with cited results
- /api/technology/decision?workload=Local%20AI&environment=Desk&constraint=None — deterministic starting point or hold

The APIs do not contain live merchant offers, user inventory, robot commands or neural embeddings. See /disclosure and /methodology before reusing conclusions.
